purpose: Camera-pan proxy gate probe: preserve cached contours when a pure motion-triggered ROI is rejected as empty or too large, instead of falling back to a full-frame refresh.
expected_effect: Avoid candidate_0041's slow-pan full-frame fallback when camera motion makes the ROI invalid.
Keep local ROI behavior unchanged when a valid bounded ROI exists.
risk: Pure motion-triggered cache reuse can leave contours stale during real object motion if the ROI detector rejects too aggressively.
Far-loss, unknown-spike, interval, and startup refreshes are intentionally not skipped, so performance spikes can remain for those sources.
